# routeros_ip_dhcp_server_alert (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) Name of the interface.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `alert_timeout` (String) Time after which the alert will be forgotten. If the same server is detected after that time, a new alert is generated. `none` means the alert never expires.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `on_alert` (String) Script that is executed when an unknown DHCP server is detected on the interface.
- `valid_server` (String) Comma separated list of MAC addresses of the DHCP servers that must not raise an alert.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `unknown_server` (String) Comma separated list of MAC addresses of the detected unknown DHCP servers. A server is removed from this list after `alert_timeout`.
